text: Binary: 1 if at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list, parsed) presents a substantive counterargument to the OP's view, meaning reasons, evidence or logic challenging the OP's position; the view is identified from OP context title and argument (context only, not measured text). Mere disagreement, insults, jokes, questions without argument, or agreement do not count. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, and 0 for an empty valid list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both OP title and argument are missing. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and stays eligible. List order is irrelevant.
